verdict.rationale: Algolia ships official open-source InstantSearch UI libraries for vanilla JS and React, built from predefined widgets that can be configured, customized or extended. The docs show the refinementList facet widget, and the React quickstart builds a search UI with filtering and pagination. Independent users praise React InstantSearch as easy to add and note support for vanilla JS, React, Vue, Angular, iOS and Android. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the search box, results/hits and pagination widgets by name (pagination is shown only through the quickstart description).
